question: True or false: a surviving decree of Emperor Theodosius I banned the Olympic Games in AD 393?
answer: False. No law in the Theodosian Code names the Games. The year 393 rests on a Byzantine chronicle written some seven centuries later. Evidence from Olympia suggests the festival went on into the fifth century, fading with its funding and cult; Remijsen argues it lasted into the 420s.
move: Ask what document a neat date rests on before repeating it.
trap: One late chronicle survived, so its tidy date became the story.
source: Remijsen, The End of Greek Athletics, 2015
reference: Remijsen, The End of Greek Athletics in Late Antiquity, Cambridge University Press, 2015
